title: Jayvee Lyn Lorejo heads to Thailand for Miss Global 2026 pageant
summary: Miss Global Philippines Jayvee Lyn Lorejo departed for Thailand on Monday, September 28, to represent the Philippines at the Miss Global 2026 pageant.
